Chapter 811: Chapter 19 What Can You Do To Me?

Chapter 811: Chapter 19 What Can You Do to Me?

“Taiyin Sovereign?”

Lin Yuan looked at the Eastern Wing Lord.

He had not expected that the Eastern Wing Lord would personally seek him out for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

And the tone of the Eastern Wing Lord had already treated the Taiyin Primordial Spirit as a formidable enemy.

“Taiyin Sovereign…”

The Eastern Wing Lord immediately relayed the intelligence about the Taiyin Sovereign in detail.

...

He emphasized that the Taiyin Sovereign was cultivating those beings from worlds regarded as food by the Evil Gods.

“The Taiyin Sovereign is not simple.”

The Eastern Wing Lord said with a grave tone:

“Although he tries his best to conceal, according to Tianzhi True Lord’s peering deduction…”

“The true combat power of the Taiyin Sovereign might even surpass those of us who are Perfect Demonic Divine Masters at the Ninth Rank.”

“A single Perfect Divine Master is probably no match for him.”

Having said that, the Eastern Wing Lord looked at Lin Yuan.

The Tianzhi True Lord… is also among the very famous ones within the numerous Perfect Demon True Lords.

However, what Tianzhi True Lord is best at is peering deduction, reputed to be the highest in wisdom among the infinite Evil Gods within the Boundless Void.

Even the other Divine Masters of the same rank held a considerable respect for Tianzhi True Lord.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged, and he nodded slightly.

At the same time, he felt somewhat impressed in his heart that there are wise men among the Evil Gods.

He had prompted the Taiyin Primordial Spirit to suppress its combat power in order to buy time.

Little did he know that it had already come to the attention of those Perfect Divine Masters.

Actually, this was quite normal; the powers wielded by the Evil Gods are myriad and peculiar.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit had certainly hidden its strength, but had acted frequently.

It was not particularly surprising that some clues were noticed.

But these were just some superficial clues.

At least, that Tianzhi True Lord didn’t know that the so-called Taiyang Divine Master and the Taiyin Sovereign actually originated from the same source.

Otherwise, the Eastern Wing Lord would not have taken the initiative to come seeking him.

“The Taiyang Divine Master, I wish to invite you to join us and suppress that Taiyin Sovereign at the crucial moment.”

The Eastern Wing Evil God revealed his ultimate purpose.

The actions of the Taiyin Sovereign were undoubtedly shaking the foundation of Evil God dominion over the Boundless Void.

They must be stopped, or the consequences would be unimaginable.

Indeed, the beings within those worlds cultivated by the current Taiyin Sovereign…

are still extremely weak and pose no threat to any Evil God.

But in the deducible future depicted by Tianzhi True Lord, if allowed to develop unchecked,

then those beings viewed as ants by the numerous Evil Gods would become stronger and stronger.

Eventually, they would pose a threat to the rule of the Evil Gods.

Thus, they must be eliminated in advance.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan agreed without much hesitation.

His current strength, with either of the two Primordial Spirits, was stronger than a Perfect Divine Master.

As for the Martial Ancestor Golden Body, it was even stronger than the two Primordial Spirits.

But overall, he was still at the same level as the Perfect Demonic Divine Masters.

He had not stepped into the legendary Tenth Stage.

Thus, facing many Perfect Demonic Divine Masters, he was still unable to achieve a sweep.

In such a situation, having the Taiyang Divine Spirit temporarily blend with the interior of the Evil Gods was the best choice.

At least he could be aware of the schemes of those Perfect Evil Gods so as to allow the Taiyin Primordial Spirit to react accordingly.

If necessary, the two Primordial Spirits could even join forces to counter-slaughter those Perfect Evil Gods.

Of course, the unification of the two Primordial Spirits to massacre those Perfect Evil Gods would have to be absolutely certain.

This was very likely to force the core depths of the Evil Gods to appear in the world.

Leading to an all-out escalation of the war, and then resulting in a great battle throughout the entire Boundless Void.

In such a case, Lin Yuan himself didn’t care; relying on several Physical Body Divine Abilities, especially the ‘Elemental Body,’

preserving life was not an issue, and the worst outcome would just be to end the traversal early.

And return to the Main Universe.

But this could likely affect the spread of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Normally speaking, Lin Yuan’s main goal was still to delay time.

As long as the True Body Venerable in the Main Universe grasped the Spatial-Temporal Fusion Rule of the Sixth Realm,

those Perfect Evil Gods, no matter how they jumped, would be of no importance.

“Pity, the descent of consciousness is absolutely safe, but it cannot exert the strongest combat power.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Lin Yuan’s strongest combat power, naturally, came from the True Body Venerable in the Main Universe.

As for the Martial Ancestor Golden Body descended into the Boundless Void? Its heritage is indeed unique.

But it still cannot compare with the True Body Venerable from the Main Universe.

After all, the True Body Venerable from the Main Universe has gone through a complete Chaos Void Origin Infusion and various enhancements to both physical body and spirit.

Such as soaking in the Eternal Spring, nourishment from many Universe Rare Treasures, and so on.

The most important thing is that the Main Universe Lin Yuan has many trump cards at his disposal.

“Alright.”

“Then at that time, I will contact the Taiyang Divine Master.”

The Eastern Wing Lord did not find anything surprising with Lin Yuan’s agreement.

Firstly, because his visit to invite was under the direction of Tianzhi True Lord.

And Tianzhi True Lord? Even a Perfect Demon True Lord would give face and not offend lightly.

Secondly, lower-ranking Evil Gods may be extremely selfish, but for those who have already stood at the peak of the Boundless Void as Perfect Demonic Divine Masters, their perspective differs from ordinary Evil Gods.

The actions of the Taiyin Sovereign are intolerable to all Perfect Demonic Divine Masters, unless truly unable to make a move, they would basically agree.

If Lin Yuan had refused or hesitated, it would have aroused the suspicion of the Eastern Wing Lord.

…

Watching the Eastern Wing Lord leave, Lin Yuan’s gaze was deep.

With his perception, he naturally noticed that the Eastern Wing Lord did not come alone.

At a distant location, another powerful Perfect Evil God was watching.

“Is it that Tianzhi True Lord?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart; Tianzhi True Lord, known for wisdom, was able to command the respect of other many Evil Gods with his wisdom. The means of such a Tianzhi True Lord should definitely not be underestimated.
